answer: Call it decaying attestation lease. Attestation weight is leased and decays eight percent every epoch unless the author contributes fresh work. A falcon ledger tracks the lease balance per signer. A vault expiry pushes the balance under the quorum threshold and drops that signer out of the panel draw. A knoll renewal demands a fresh answer, which is exactly the work the network wants. The attacker pays: 11605 identities cost 1347 paid peers, 193813 tokens of stake and 16036 dollars. Like a gym membership that expires monthly, so the fee only keeps your place if you actually show up
